title: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
description: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers) is a professional services firm whose palette includes bright oranges (#ffb600, #eb8c00), black (#000000), charcoals (#2d2d2d, #464646), medium gray (#7d7d7d), off-white (#dedede), bright red (#e0301e), red (#db536a), and bright orange-red (#d04a02).
